pages.title: Astro Miner
pages.text: A robot that digs asteroids and brings ore home by itself. It needs a dock on the surface and power. One player may have up to 6 miners. Titanium, aluminum and iron are found here.

pages.title: Short range telepads
pages.text: A pair of telepads moves you between two points in one world. Both ends need power and matching addresses. Handy for large bases on the $(l:space/planets/asteroids)asteroids$().

pages.title: Astro Miner Base
pages.text: The dock where the miner brings ore.
